name: Lingam
description: Framed for a crime he didn't commit, a kabaddi hero gets pushed into a world he never wanted and ultimately becomes a feared name.

videos.title: First Wave of the Ocean
videos.overview: Lingam's long-awaited police appointment is delayed, pushing him into a high-stakes tournament. But when a fierce match turns violent, a shocking murder changes everything.

videos.title: Shadow of the Cry
videos.overview: The police finally track down Lingam. Inside the prison, he endures brutal torture, humiliation and violence that slowly harden him into a ruthless and emotionally scarred man.

videos.title: The Fury of Fate
videos.overview: The cops harass Lingam by making him the go-to suspect for any crime. Chelladurai also underhandedly uses him as a henchman. Pushed to his limits, Lingam's anger boils over.

videos.title: The Sea Rises
videos.overview: Lingam joins Chellapandian's illicit liquor network and plays a major role in expanding his business. After saving his boss from a deadly attack, Lingam earns his trust.

videos.title: The Season of Betrayal
videos.overview: Lingam marries Ponmalar, hoping to finally build a peaceful life. But a conspiracy unfolds involving poisoned liquor. Enraged, Lingam begins hunting down those responsible.

videos.title: The Chill of a Mild Tremor
videos.overview: Driven by revenge for Chellapandian's death, Lingam hunts down Samiyappan. While helping a young couple, he finds himself in a crisis and is compelled to go into hiding.

videos.title: The Breaking Palm Tree
videos.overview: Lingam rises as the undisputed kingpin of Kanyakumari. As his friendship with Thiru deteriorates, Lingam discovers the puppeteer pulling Chellapandian and Samiyappan's strings.

videos.title: The Burning Sea
videos.overview: Devastated by Bhaskar's death, Lingam swears revenge against Chelladurai, adding to his mother's misery. Lingam gives Chelladurai 30 days to prepare for the consequences.
